evidence.excerpt: To address these limitations, we propose WPBench, a comprehensive, fair, and extensible benchmark for wind power forecasting.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Yet existing benchmarks fall short of supporting systematic evaluation in four key aspects: 1) limited coverage of wind power scenarios across turbine scale, variable composition, and spatial structure; 2) incomplete coverage of forecasting model families; 3) evaluation metrics misaligned with wind power requirements; and 4) limited structure-aware diagnostics beyond individual temporal patterns.
